verses.text: Ha t'a chonhab' Cesarea ay jun winh skuch Cornelio, yajal yaj winh t'a jun makan heb' soldado skuchan aj Italia.
Syak' wal och spensar winh t'a Dios. Te ay xiwk'olal winh t'ay yet' jantak heb' ayek' t'a yol spat winh yet'ok. Tzijtum tas syak'pax winh t'a heb' israel te meb'a'. Slesalwi wal winh t'a Dios.
Haxo junel t'a tz'eymajk'ualxo, ix yilan winh icha t'a wayich, ay jun yángel Dios ayoch t'a yol jun cuarto b'aj ayek' winh chi'. Ix yalan jun ángel chi' t'a winh: --Cornelio, xchi.

Ix och k'elan winh t'ay. Ix te xiw winh yuj. --Mamin, ¿tas tzal t'ayin? xchi winh t'ay. Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a winh: --Ha Dios ix ab'an a lesal. Ix yilanpax juntzanh a silab' ix ak' t'a heb' meb'a'. Maj satlaj sk'ool t'a juntzanh chi'.
Ha , chekb'at jaywanhok heb' winh winak t'a chonhab' Jope, yik b'at yik'kot winhaj Simón heb' winh, haton winh skuchpax Pedro.
Ayek' winh t'a spat jun winh sk'exul, haton jun winh smunlaj yet' nok' tz'uum. Ha spat winh chi', ha t'a sti' ha' mar ay, xchi jun ángel chi' t'a winh.

Ixlajwi spax jun ángel chi', ix yawtankot chawanh heb' winh schekab' winhaj Cornelio chi' yet' pax jun winh soldado yak'umaltaxon serwil winh yaji. Ha jun winh soldado chi', anhej t'a Dios ayoch spensar winh.
Jantaknhej tas ix yal jun ángel chi', ix laj yal winh t'a heb' winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix schekanb'at heb' winh t'a chonhab' Jope chi'.
Haxo t'a junxo k'u t'a chimk'ualil, ayik wan sk'och heb' winh t'a slak'anil Jope chi', haxo winhaj Pedro chi', ix k'e winh lesal t'a spanhanil yib'anh spat winhaj Simón chi'.
Ayik ayek' winh ta', ix och swejel winh. Ix sk'anan wa sb'a winh. Palta haxo yik wan to sb'oji tas ol yab'lej winh chi', icha t'a wayichal
ix aj yilan winh sjakwi satcha'anh. Haxo ix yilan winh ichato ay jun k'apak yamb'il schikintak schanhil, ix emul t'a spanhanil yib'anh pat b'aj ayek' winh chi'.
Haxo t'a yol jun k'apak chi', hata' ayoch junjun makan nok' nok'. Ay nok' chanhe' yok. Ay pax nok' chan yet' nok' much.
Ixlajwi yemul jun chi', ix yab'an winhaj Pedro chi', ix och jun lolonel, ix yalan icha tik: --Pedro, mak'cham juntzanh nok' tik a chi'a, xchi.
Palta ix yalan winh: --Ach Wajalil, max yal-laj, yujto manta jun elok tzin chi junok komon tasi, ma junok tas ay yowalil yuj ley Moisés, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan junelxo: --Ha juntzanh tas syal Dios to malaj yowalil, a hachxo tik, manh ala' to ay yowalil, xchi.
Oxel ix alchaj icha chi'. Ix lajwinhej chi', ix ik'jixik'e jun k'apak chi' t'a satcha'anh.
Wanto snaan winhaj Pedro tas yaj jun chi', ix k'och heb' winh schekab' winhaj Cornelio t'a sti' jun pat chi'. Toxo ix sk'anb'ej heb' winh yab'i b'aj ay spat winhaj Simón chi'.
Yuj chi' ix awajoch heb' winh, ix sk'anb'an heb' winh: --¿Ay am ek' winhaj Simón t'a tik, winh skuchpax Pedro? xchi heb' winh.
Hanheja' wanto snaan winhaj Pedro yuj juntzanh ix yil chi', ix yalan Yespíritu Dios t'a winh: --Ay oxwanh heb' winh winak tzach k'anb'ani.
Yuj chi' emanh. Ixik yet' heb' winh, manh chab'k'olalok tzach b'ati, yujto a in ix in chekkot heb' winh, xchi t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix emta winh b'aj ayek' heb' winh schekab' winhaj Cornelio chi'. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh: --Ina in tzin he k'anb'ej tik. ¿Tas he chekab'il t'ayin yuj chi' tzex jawi? xchi winh.

Ix yalan heb' winh t'a winh: --Ay jun winh yajal soldado skuch Cornelio. Te wach' sb'eyb'al winh, syak'paxem sb'a winh t'a Dios. Te wach' winh t'a yichanh heb' etisraelal smasanil. Haxo jun yángel Dios ix halan t'a winh to schekkot heb' schekab' winh yik tzach yik'b'at heb' t'a spat winh, yik wach' smaklej yab' winh tas ol ala', xchi heb' winh t'a winhaj Pedro chi'.
Yuj chi' ix ik'jioch heb' winh t'a yol pat chi' yuj winh. Hata' ix ek' ak'wal yuj heb' winh. Haxo t'a junxo k'u ix b'at winh yet' heb' winh. Ix b'at jaywanh heb' creyente aj Jope chi' yuk'lewok winh.
Hato t'a schab'jial ix k'och heb' t'a chonhab' Cesarea. Haxo winhaj Cornelio ix tanhwan sk'och heb' ta'. Toxo ix yawtejkot heb' sk'ab' yok winh yet' juntzanhxo heb' yamigo winh.
Ayik wan sk'och winhaj Pedro chi', ix elta winhaj Cornelio chi' t'a sti' spat. Ix schaan winh sk'och winh. Ix em kuman winh yak'em sb'a t'a winhaj Pedro chi'.
Palta a winhaj Pedro chi' ix ketzank'e waan winh. Ix yalan winh t'a winh icha tik: --Q'ueanh linhan, yujto ketanimail ko b'a, xchi winh.
Wan slolon heb' winh, ix och heb' winh t'a yol pat. Ix yilan winhaj Pedro chi' to tzijtumxo heb' molaneq'ui.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a heb': --Ex wetanimail, eyojtak to a onh israel onh tik, ay yowalil ko k'umlan ko b'a yet' junok ch'ok chonhab'il, ma koch t'a yol spat. Palta ha Dios ix ak'an wojtakejeli to max yal walani to ay yowalil tzin k'umej junok mach.
Yuj chi' malaj tas ix wala' ayik ix b'at in eyik'ankoti. Xal tiknaik, alek t'ayin, tas yuj ix b'at in eyik'koti, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Cornelio chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Yab' am icha hora tik oxji, wan in lesalwi t'a yol in pat tik, ichataxon tzin k'ulej t'a junjun tz'eymajk'ualil. Ay jun sch'ox sb'a t'ayin, kopopi kilan spichul.
Yalan t'ayin: Cornelio, ha Dios ix ab'an a lesal. Ix snaanpaxkot juntzanh a silab' tzak' t'a heb' meb'a'.

Haxo tiknaik, chekb'at jaywanhok winak t'a chonhab' Jope, b'at yik'ankot winhaj Simón heb', skuch pax Pedro. Ayek' winh t'a spat jun winh sk'exul, haton jun winh smunlaj yet' nok' tz'uum. Ha spat winh chi', ha t'a sti' ha' mar ay, xchi.

Slajwi chi', in chekanb'at heb' in chekab' ach sayeq'ui. Yuj wal Dios t'ayach ix a k'anab'ajej a koti. Ha tiknaik, ayonh ek' ko masanil t'a yichanh Dios Kajal. Yuj chi' sko snib'ej skab'i jantaknhej tas alb'ilkan t'ayach yuj, yik tzalan t'ayonh, xchi winhaj Cornelio chi' t'a winh.
Haxo winhaj Pedro chi', ix och ijan winh yalan t'a heb': --Ha tiknaik wojtak to t'a wal yel, jun lajannhej yelk'och masanil anima t'a yichanh Dios.
Ha heb' xiw t'a Dios, wach'chom manh israelok heb', ste tzalaj yet' heb' tato wach' sb'eyb'al heb'.
Ha Dios ak'jinakkan slolonel t'ayonh a onh israel onh tik. Yalannakkan t'ayonh to ay junk'olal yuj Jesucristo, haton Kajal ko masanil.
Ha exxo tik, ina eyojtak tas ix sk'ulej Dios t'a ko lugar. Ha t'a Galilea elnak yich, ayik slajwinak yalankanel slolonel Dios winhaj Juan, a slajwinak yak'an bautizar heb' anima winh.

Eyojtak to ha Dios yak'nak Yespíritu t'a Jesús aj Nazaret, yak'annakpax spoder t'ay. Eyojtak paxi to a Jesús ix kolwaj t'a heb' anima. Jantaknhej heb' ixtab'il yuj winh diablo, ix laj yak' b'oxok sk'ool heb'. Icha chi' yutejnak sb'a yujto ha Dios ayoch yet'ok.

Ha onh tik skak' testigoal ko b'a yuj juntzanh tastak ix sk'ulej chi'. Jantaknhej tas ix ek' sk'ulej t'a yol yik Judea yet' t'a chonhab' Jerusalén, ix kila'. Ixlajwi chi', ix kulusajk'e yuj heb' wetisraelal. Icha chi' ix yutej heb' smilanchamok.
Palta haxo t'a schab'jial ix pitzwixi yuj Dios. Yuj spoder Dios chi' ix sch'ox sb'a t'ayonh.

Palta maj sch'oxlaj sb'a t'a masanil heb' anima. Anhej t'ayonh ix sch'ox sb'a, yujto atax t'a peka' sik'b'ilonhxokanel yuj yik tzonh och stestigook. Onh wa pax yet'ok ayik toxo ix pitzwixi t'a skal heb' chamnak chi'.
Ix yalankan t'ayonh to yowalil tzek' kalel yab'ixal t'a heb' anima, to ha Dios ak'jinak yopisio sch'olb'itan tas yaj heb' anima smasanil, wach'chom heb' pitzanto ma heb' chamnakxo.

Atax t'a peka', ayokto yalannakkanel yab'ixal Jesús heb' schekab' Dios. Yalnakkan junjun heb' to a jantaknhej heb' ol ak'anoch Jesús chi' t'a sk'ool, ol ak'jokkan lajwok smul heb' yuj, xchi winhaj Pedro chi' t'a heb'.
Haxo yik wan yalan winhaj Pedro chi', ix ochkan Yespíritu Dios t'a masanil heb' wan yab'an chi'.
Haxo heb' creyente aj Israel ajun yet' winhaj Pedro chi', ix te sat sk'ool heb', yujto ix yak'pax Yespíritu Dios t'a heb' manh israelok.
Yujto ix yab' heb' to ch'okch'ok ti'al syal heb' b'aj ix ochkan kajan Espíritu Santo chi'. Ix yab'anpax heb' yalan wach' lolonel heb' t'a Dios. Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Pedro chi':
--Max yal sko kachoch waan heb' tik, yik max ak'ji bautizar heb'. Ina to ix ak'ji Yespíritu Dios t'a heb' icha ix aj yak'ji t'ayonh, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Pedro chi' to tz'ak'ji bautizar heb' t'a sb'i Jesucristo. Ixlajwi yak'ji bautizar heb' chi', ix sk'anan pawor heb' t'a winh, yik wach' tz'aj jayeok k'ual winh yet' heb'.
